items.en: "So quick to start a fight? You've only just signed up."
"I seek a Path not so different from yours."
Nod and make an appropriately serious face
"I can tell."
"You should be. That death is hell I would not wish upon my worst enemy."
"I've met him. His views are... unique."
"I've met him. Brother Cotton is a true visionary."
"Yes. He's a snake that puts on a polite mask to charm people."
"No. But I'd like to."
"No. But I'd like to. Then do what must be done."
"No. I have my own Path to follow."
"Yes."
"No." (lie)
"I've given your proposal some thought. I will find your missing agent."
"I want to talk about your proposal, about the missing agent."
"You mentioned payment for the job."
"What if I can't find him? What if he is dead?"
"This could be dangerous. I need more details."
Ask about something else
"What was his last known position?"
"Then I will find Bornanew."
"I can promise only to try."
"Can you tell me more about his mission?"
"Can you tell me more about Bornanew?"
"You sound... a little bloodthirsty when it comes to the Path."
"Is this about Brother Cotton?"
"He is acting as your spy."
"Is it possible he turned on you?"
"I accept your view of him, but you must consider the possibility."
"Then he may be... in trouble."
Speak of other matters
"You don't know that he's dead."
"... Again?"
"And you still want me to deliver your 'message' to Cotton."
"I'm looking for a man named Jethro Bornanew."
"I'm looking for a Path recruiter."
"And I shall send my marines to kill and burn if you don't give me what I want."
"And I will bomb your pathetic cult from orbit if I don't get what I want."
"This is a terrible misunderstanding! It's not what it looks like."
"I want Jethro Bornanew."
"Make him use comms. An exception. For me."
"Gee, that's too bad..." (reach for controls)
"A meeting, then."
"I'm looking for someone who may have joined the Path."
"I'm looking for someone who recruits for the Path."
"Look, he had to talk to someone, right? A recruiter?"
"He came here to join the Luddic Path. His name is Jethro Bornanew."
"I'm searching for Jethro Bornanew."
"Yours as well."
"I simply want to talk."
"I promise, I mean no ill-will. You have friends in the Church."
"I promise, I mean no ill-will. You have friends in the Church." (lie)
"You know what I mean. I'm looking for a person. A recruiter."
"I understand, but I'm looking for someone to talk to."
"Are you being intentionally dense? Just give me a straight answer."
"It is not my intention to cause you trouble, I'm simply looking for a man."
"Perhaps a donation would help jog your memory?"
Cut the comms
"Who should I ask?"
"Who should I ask?"
"... Is it Brother Cotton?"
"So who should I ask?"
"Hey, that was my tea!"
"I'm searching for a man called Jethro Bornanew."
Thank him for his time and leave.
"I'm after information, not killing. It's just talk."
"Agreed."
"It's just talk, how about 1000?"

"They're afraid. So might-makes-right and terror rules. You think this is righteous?"
"They respect you. Because you are willing to do what needs to be done."
"How can you murder a man in cold blood and think yourself righteous?"
"You murder because you feel like its right? That's insane."
"What you say about faith alone, not deeds, it... makes sense."
"You do what you want and think faith makes it good? That's insane."
"What you say about following faith alone, it... makes sense."
Change the subject
"I expect some worldly authority will judge you, and not well."
"How much blood must you spill to be allowed into Heaven?"
"What good deeds of yours outweigh such casual murder?"
"You killed an evil man? Then I spoke too soon."
"To finding lost things."
"Are you allowed to drink this?"
"Got a prayer for this?"
"That led me to you. Will you shoot me as well?"
"I could kill you."
"I could have you killed."
"Yes, you did him a mercy."
"He drank too much anyway."
"Mazalot? Why?"

"I'm not going to stop my search."
"If that is what the Path demands, I will cease." (lie)
"I serve the Faith, and I search for a servant of the Faith. What would battle serve?"
"I wish to serve the Path; finding Bornanew will serve the cause we share."
"Finding Bornanew will serve the Path. Have faith."
"What else did Brother Cotton say? Is that all?"
"I need to contact Brother Cotton. I have something for him."
"You demand what your puny fleet cannot impose. Flee now."
"You talk a lot. Sure you're up for this?"
"Stand down, $brotherOrSister. I am following the orders of Livewell Cotton."
"We are no fools. Save your strength, $brotherOrSister."
"You would be a fool, and a heretic besides, to stand in my way."
"Yes, over tea. Would that we all could serve the Path with such grace and charm."
"It must; truly we are blessed to walk aside him."

"Your administrator, Dardan Kato, seems to have a low opinion of 'Luddies'."
"I'm looking for a man who may be involved in the Luddic Path."
"This is very important. His name is Jethro Bornanew."
"I share your desire to both respect the Faith... and handle this matter quietly. With your help."
"I have credentials from Gens Yaribay. Horus Yaribay personally asked me to investigate this matter." (lie)
"I am pursuing this matter for an archcurate of the Church."
"I understand. Let us speak of other things."
"Kato, Yaribay, what difference does it make?"
"Yaribay wants to find Jethro Bornanew. He may be involved with Pathers."
"I'm looking for Jethro Bornanew. He may be involved with the Path."
"Is there some kind of problem?"
"Jethro. Jethro Bornanew."
"Jethro Bornanew must be found. If not by me, another will come."
"I understand. I won't tell the administrator." (lie)
"I understand. I won't tell the administrator."
"I'm looking for whoever is in charge of the Luddic Path around here."
"I need to make contact with the Luddic Path on Mazalot."
"You know what, forget I said anything about Yaribay."
"I'm afraid not. I have to protect your identity."
"Sure." (lie)
"Thank you for your service."
"Sounds serious. I'll keep my nose clean."
"'Worth it'? So you know what the Path will pay for collaboration?"
